note: Jamaica, read on the Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency's own pages (pica.gov.jm) on 2026-10-30. CARICOM nationals holding the CSME skills certificate, and their dependants, get CARICOM Unconditional Landing, a stamp letting them live, study and work in Jamaica without a work permit, valid until the passport expires and then transferred (JM$10,000 for a first application, JM$5,000 to transfer); the groups kept are the CSME states as Belize's immigration department lists them, Jamaica aside (the PICA page names none). Permanent residence lets a foreign national live and work without restriction, applied for in Jamaica (among its categories, employment for those working in Jamaica over 3 years, retirement and marriage), processed within 3 to 6 months (6 kept), JM$100,000. The work permit itself is the Ministry of Labour and Social Security's, whose page answered with a captcha, so it isn't written; the years naturalisation asks aren't read.

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Jamaica), Unconditional Landing
sources.said: Unconditional Landing is a type of extension of stay, granted to a foreign national that allows them to live in Jamaica while being able to attend school or work without having to obtain a student visa or a work permit, respectively. ... This stamp expires, when the holder’s foreign passport expires after which, a transfer of the stamp from the expired passport to the new passport is required. ... CARICOM Unconditional Landing (CUL) CARICOM Nationals with the CSME certificate and their dependents.

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Jamaica), Permanent Residence
sources.said: This allows a foreign national to live and work in Jamaica without restrictions on their stay, without submitting an application for a work permit or Jamaican citizenship. ... Applications are processed within 3 to 6 months ... Employment – for foreign nationals working in the island for more than 3 years

sources.title: Passport, Immigration and Citizenship Agency (Jamaica), Fees
sources.said: Permanent Residence Application JM$100,000.00 Unconditional Landing – First-time application JM$10,000.00 – Renewal/transfer to new passport JM$5,000.00
